text:
jordan: quick heads-up — A/B shows the quantized reranker (q4x) down ~0.018 MRR in prod for cohort B, NDCG looks flat. offline eval with our usual harness disagrees (+0.25 MRR). pattern: affected queries return docs with lots of anchor/link text (nav bars, TOCs, 'click here' links). maria: do you have an example thread/doc we can inspect? jordan: yep, redacted example below: ```json { "query": "how to set up CI for node projects", "doc_id": "doc-2048", "title": "Node CI best practices", "body_html": "
Home Click here

Setup

Use GitHub Actions...

Table of contents: Step 1 Step 2
", "body_text": "Node CI best practices Setup Use GitHub Actions..." } ``` prod serving pipeline concatenates `title + body_html` for the reranker input (bug), whereas offline harness used `title + body_text` (stripped). that extra anchor text inflates token counts and changes tokenization. chris: tokenizer diffs matter here too — staging bumped tokenizer v2.1 which splits anchor phrases differently. quantized logits are tighter; small deltas flip rank-1 vs rank-2 which hurts MRR but barely moves NDCG. tie-breaker semantics also differ: prod falls back to `published_ts`, harness stable-sorts by id. sam: suggested repro steps: 1) run harness with exact serving concat (title+raw_html) 2) align tokenizer to prod (v2.0 vs v2.1) 3) run paired bootstrap on anchor-heavy slice. my command: ``` ./eval_harness --model reranker:q4x --cohort anchor_heavy_slice.jsonl \ --preproc=serving_concat_rawhtml --tokenizer=v2.0 \ --tie-break=published_ts --metrics mrr,ndcg --bootstrap 2000 \ --out=tmp/anchor_repro.json ``` ci-bot: CI job started for `reranker/q4x/anchor-repro` — https://ci.internal/6130001234/jobs/45 :construction_worker: maria: if this repros, quick mitigation is to canonicalize scoring input to prefer `body_text` (low risk) in the serving layer, and add a synthetic anchor-heavy golden to the harness. i'll add unit tests that assert identical ordering across quant and fp32 for that golden doc set. jordan: i reproduced locally with `serving_concat_rawhtml` + tokenizer v2.0 and see -0.015 MRR (closer to prod). forcing `body_text` only makes offline match prod within noise. chris: long-term we should: a) standardize preprocessing for model onboarding (list exact concat rule), b) include both raw_html and stripped_text variants in the eval checklist, c) unify tie-breaker with prod. i'll update the onboarding doc and PR a checklist item. sam: filing PR #1301 with the anchor-heavy cohort + harness tests and a regression alert for the new slice. also proposing a monitor: alert when MRR drop > 0.01 on `anchor-heavy` over a 1h window. maria: i'm owning the hotfix to prefer `body_text` in serving (patch + rollback plan). jordan please coordinate the rollout. jordan: rolling the fix now with a 30m watch, rollback window in place. thanks all :thumbsup:
